quote.text: The person who chases two rabbits catches none. Pick the one thing that closes the deal and do only that.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check GHL/Calendly for new bookings before noon.
focus: Yesterday's Capital One "card declined" alerts have NOT repeated — today Capital One only sent a routine credit-score-improved notice. Still confirm the Meta ad account funding card has room before you trust delivery, since one more decline silences your only live lead source.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at $17 CPL — that's ~$460 spent on contacts who never booked. The bottleneck is follow-up, not traffic. Run a call-and-text blitz through every unbooked GHL lead with a direct booking link today.

Instantly (billing lapsed) and LinkedIn (paused) are both dead, so FB Ads is your only channel and it has produced zero clients. Send 20 manual outbound DMs or emails to home-service businesses today to open a second path to your first close.
